Preparedness Month.

and conversations that make all the

September is National Preparedness

awareness about the importance of being
ready for disasters and emergencies.

encourage you to talk to your family,
friends, and neighbors about how you
will stay connected before, during, and
after a disaster. To build or update
your emergency kits so that they include
several days worth of food, water, and
first aid supplies. Don't forget
medication, essential documents, and pet
supplies that can be packed quickly if
you need to evacuate.

prepare for an emergency is before it
